name: topic_merge_20ng
description: Oracle starts with an over-fragmented clustering (k=7) on 20 Newsgroups and progressively merges related topic clusters. Tests that merge operations work correctly on topic-based data and that coherence improves. Mirrors the amazon_reviews topic_merge scenario for cross-dataset comparison.

oracle_turns.raw_text: There are too many clusters. I see two that both deal with science — one about medical and health topics, the other about space exploration and astronomy. Merge them into a single 'Science' cluster.
I also see clusters about cars and about baseball that are both recreational hobbies. Combine them into one 'Recreation & Sports' cluster.
The computer graphics cluster and whatever is left about technology can also be merged — call it 'Technology & Computing'.
That looks much cleaner. The remaining clusters now have clear, distinct themes. I'm happy with this — no further changes needed.
